description: Defines the abstract base class google_breakpad::Language for language-specific operations in the Breakpad symbol dumper, including virtual methods and static instances for C++, Java, and Assembler.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Abstract base class for language-specific operations related to symbol dumping, with virtual methods for name qualification and a destructor.

methods.name: ~Language
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the Language class.

methods.name: HasFunctions
methods.description: Returns true if the language has functions to which line numbers can be assigned.

methods.name: MakeQualifiedName
methods.description: Constructs a fully-qualified, language-appropriate name based on parent and child names.
